verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs route agent payments through the merchant's existing rails. ACP and UCP tokens are processed by the existing Braintree integration, and Store Sync orders reach the merchant's order system "just as it would from any other channel." Agent orders also inherit the standard published fee schedule, and transaction details are reachable through the toolkit and the webhooks on the same REST surface. That implies agent payments reconcile like any other channel, but no document addresses settlement, payouts or reporting for agent-originated payments directly. missing for 10: explicit payout/settlement documentation for agent-originated payments, agent-channel identification in reporting or settlement reports, documented reconciliation guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
